originalTitle: Dow Jones Futures Rise, Oil Prices Dive As Trump Shifts On Iran; SpaceX, AMD, Sandisk, Eli Lilly Earnings Loom

chineseTitle: 随着特朗普转向伊朗，道琼斯期货上涨，油价跳水； SpaceX、AMD、Sandisk、礼来公司盈利迫在眉睫
